questions.stem: What role do contractions of the uterus muscles play during birth?

options.text: They push the baby out through the dilated cervix and vagina
They produce oxytocin in the uterus
They close the cervix to protect the baby

questions.explanation: The rhythmic contractions of the uterus muscles push the baby headfirst through the dilated cervix and out through the vagina during the second stage of labour.
